app.name: Bin Rota
app.description: rotates bin duty between the people in a household and reminds them by text message on the evening before bin day, using collection dates from the local council
app.audience: UK households who share bin duty

summary: Everything you enter stays on your phone. Bin Rota has no account, no server and no cloud database, and the Owner never receives your data.
The app reads your contacts only when you choose someone from the contact picker, and copies only that person's name and phone number.
Reminder texts go from your own phone to the people on your rota, through your mobile network.
To get collection dates, the app sends your property reference (UPRN) or calendar link to your council's collection service.
There are no ads, analytics or trackers.

data.type: Rota members' names and mobile numbers (typed in or picked from your contacts)
data.purpose: Show the rota, work out whose turn it is, and address the reminder texts
data.lawful_basis: Legitimate interests: running the household rota you set up. The Owner never receives this data.
data.storage: Only on your device, in the app's private storage
data.retention: Until you remove the person, clear the app's data or uninstall the app

data.type: Collection address reference (council UPRN), or the calendar link or manual pattern you enter
data.purpose: Look up your bin collection dates
data.lawful_basis: Legitimate interests: providing the reminders you asked for
data.storage: On your device; sent to the collection service named below each time dates are refreshed
data.retention: Until you change it, clear the app's data or uninstall the app

data.type: Reminder settings and app records (reminder time, whose turn is next, the automated-message sign-off, cached collection dates and a log of the last reminder sent)
data.lawful_basis: Legitimate interests: providing the reminders you asked for
data.retention: Until you clear the app's data or uninstall the app

data.type: Reminder text messages (recipient number and message text)
data.purpose: Tell rota members whose turn it is and which bins are collected
data.lawful_basis: Legitimate interests: providing the reminders you asked for
data.storage: Sent from your phone through your mobile network, like any other text; kept in your phone's messages as your Messages app normally does
data.retention: As set by your Messages app and mobile network; the app keeps no copy

permissions.name: Contacts (READ_CONTACTS)
permissions.reason: Used only when you tap to pick a person from your contacts. The app reads that one contact's name and phone number and saves them to the rota. It never uploads or scans your address book.

permissions.name: Send SMS (SEND_SMS, direct-download version only)
permissions.reason: Sends the reminder texts from your own SIM at the time you choose. Normal text charges from your network apply. The Google Play version does not ask for this: it shows a notification and opens your Messages app with the text ready for you to send.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Shows reminder and status notifications on your phone. Notifications are created on the device; no push service is used.

permissions.name: Alarms, run at start-up and network access
permissions.reason: Schedule the reminder for the right time, restore it after the phone restarts, and fetch collection dates.

third_party_services.name: Greater Cambridge Shared Waste Service collection calendar
third_party_services.purpose: Provides bin collection dates when you enter a gc: council reference
third_party_services.data_sent: Your property's UPRN and your device's IP address

third_party_services.name: The calendar (iCal) address you enter, if any
third_party_services.purpose: Provides bin collection dates from a council calendar feed
third_party_services.data_sent: A request to that address, with your device's IP address

privacy.backups: If Android backup is turned on for your Google account, Android may include the app's settings (including rota names and numbers) in your device backup, so they can be restored to a new phone. Google stores those backups under your account and its own privacy policy; the Owner cannot see them. You can turn this off in your phone's backup settings.
privacy.deletion_note: Because your data is only on your device, you can delete it at any time: remove people in the app, clear the app's storage in Android settings, or uninstall the app. The Owner holds no copy to delete.
